title: Extract scan join execution
problem: scan/mod.rs still carried join orchestration, join key extraction, join projection pushdown, and indexed join probe helpers.
approach: Move execute_join, apply_join_step, join key extraction, projection helpers, and indexed join probe helpers into the new submodule.
Keep public query-facing Executor::execute_join API stable.
risk_controls: Do not alter join semantics or scan_single_table behavior.
Run cargo check --lib and join-focused SQL integration tests.
